disposition.summary: Confirmed upstream codex-runtime Agent Runtime defect: shared and isolated Codex runtimes could construct mutually exclusive approval and sandbox flags, obscure pre-session CLI failures behind a missing-result error, and overstate sandbox application before thread start. The working-tree fix establishes a fail-closed exclusive policy, truthful receipts, startup error precedence, and synthetic regression coverage; immutable release and original Engine retry evidence remain separate resolution gates.
